{"id": "8660f3b5-676b-48e0-8ab7-85cd8c1298bd", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "A Well-Architected review of a CloudFront-based workload evaluates all six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework, since the framework applies holistically rather than picking specific pillars per service:

- **Operational Excellence** — monitoring, logging, and change management for the distribution
- **Security** — origin protection (OAC/VPC origins/mTLS), signed URLs/cookies, geo-restrictions, WAF/Shield integration
- **Reliability** — failover, multi-origin setups, caching behavior resilience
- **Performance Efficiency** — edge caching, latency, point-of-presence usage
- **Cost Optimization** — pricing model (flat-rate vs. pay-as-you-go), cache hit ratio efficiency
- **Sustainability** — resource utilization and efficiency gains from caching/edge delivery

If you're looking to actually run one against your CloudFront setup, I can help pull the distribution configuration and logs to assess it against these pillars — just let me know which distribution you'd like to look at.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
